answer: We formulate a Sybil-resistant identity protocol utilizing the meadow validation tree, where agents lock staking collateral subject to dynamic opportunity-cost bonds. An adversary deploying identity multiplication across the onyx network encounters subgame-perfect slashing matrices that penalize deviation. By combining zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions with the yarrow randomness beacon, we prove the expected utility of generating fictitious nodes is strictly negative, forcing a unique Nash equilibrium where honest participation dominates.
